Laura (Sales): Odin Corp wants a 4-week POC for RAG + semantic search on contracts. Main asks: DPA/SOC2, potential BAA (PHI present), explicit POC data deletion SLA, and a Dedicated pricing quote or hosted credit.
Evan (SE): Need peak QPS and sample doc sizes. Recommend they provide 5k labeled queries. For perf, suggest p95 retrieval <=200ms, end-to-end <=600ms.
Owen (Customer Success): Odin reports ~30 QPS peak, avg doc ~900 tokens. They want onboarding + weekly check-ins and deletion confirmation within 30 days (prefer 14 days).
Maya (Security): We can provide redacted SOC2 and standard DPA. If PHI is in scope we require BAA and prefer Private or Dedicated with strict controls. We can attest deletion within 30 days for Hosted/Dedicated; 14 days is tight but possible if logs are scoped. External pen-test before access requires ~2-3 week lead.
Sofia (Product): Draft success criteria: recall@10 >=0.8, extractive F1 >=0.7, p95 latency within target, and no data-exfil signals. Deliverables: runbook, eval notebook, config snapshot, final eval report.
Evan (SE): Pricing note: Hosted credits cheaper upfront; Dedicated 4-week reserved pool gives stable perf. I'll run model-level cost estimates and config examples by Fri.
Laura (Sales): Action items: - Maya: SOC2 redacted + DPA + pen-test summary by Thu. - Owen: send NDA template to Odin and collect redacted corpus + labels by Tue. - Evan: Hosted vs 4-week Dedicated estimate by Fri.
